description: This file contains implementation of fused AdamW optimizer kernel functions optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including functions to handle parameter updates with and without AMSGrad, device checks, and interface functions for MPS-specific optimization.

methods.name: _fused_adamw_kernel_mps_
methods.description: Performs fused AdamW parameter update on MPS backend, with options for AMSGrad and device type handling.

methods.name: _fused_adamw_kernel_mps
methods.description: Dispatches the fused AdamW kernel call, handling CPU or GPU device conditions, and calls the core kernel implementation accordingly.
